description: This annual compendium is Bhutan's official statistical source on farming and food, compiled by the Policy and Planning Division of the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock. The edition published in 2025 covers 2015 to 2024 and runs to 128 pages of tables. It gives harvested area and production of cereals, oilseeds, pulses, roots, spices, vegetables and fruit; milk, meat and egg output; exports and imports of major food items with India and other countries in volume and value; commodities auctioned through the Food Corporation of Bhutan; land use and irrigation schemes by district; imports of machinery, fertiliser and plant protection chemicals; average retail prices at the Centenary Farmers Market in Thimphu; and station rainfall and temperature. The reports are free to download as PDFs from the ministry's statistics page. Caveats: the tables are inside PDFs, some series stop in 2023, and the document is marked all rights reserved. Coverage is national with district breakdowns. Simulation uses: estimating Bhutan's dependence on food imports from India for supply disruption scenarios, and linking crop output and prices to monsoon rainfall.
